title: I Saw Spawn #1
desc: The sequel to last year’s acclaimed Christmas horror story, I SAW SANTA! Writers CHRIS KILLIAN & ANDREW SANDERS take readers back to the twisted world of serial killers, Santa, and of course Spawn. The North Pole is shaken by a gruesome massacre that bears the signature of serial killer, Charlie Kohl. As Santa Claus investigates, dark forces begin to corrupt Santa's workshop from within, and it’s clear Spawn is the only one who might be able to put a stop to this terribly twisted Christmas. The tale unfolds with the glorious art of TODOR HRISTOV. Truly a new Holiday tradition not to be missed!
